title: chrysopsis villosa var. sessiliflora
intro: Chrysopsis villosa var. sessiliflora, commonly known as a variety of the bushy goldenrod, is a flowering plant native to the southeastern United States. As a medicinal plant, it is valued for its various health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Chrysopsis villosa var. sessiliflora include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
